problem:
What linear transformation is represented by the following matrix
$[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 12 & 1\end{aligned}]?$

choices.value: A stretch of scale factor $12$ in the $x$-direction
A stretch of scale factor $12$ in the $y$-direction
A horizontal shear with a shear factor of $12$
A vertical shear with a shear factor of $12$
A stretch of scale factor $\frac{1}{12}$ in the $y$-direction

activity_context.topic_title: Shear and Stretch as Linear Transformations
